# Ruby Gillis

## Overview

- **Age:** 17 (at the end of Anne of Avonlea)
- **Gender:** Female
- **Status:** Alive
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island
- **Role:** Schoolteacher

## Appearance

Ruby is considered one of the prettiest girls in Avonlea, known for her fair complexion, clear blue eyes, and long, glossy golden hair. She takes great pride in her looks and dresses fashionably to emphasize her delicate, attractive features. Her bright, cheerful appearance often attracts the attention of local boys.

## Personality

Ruby is sentimental, giggly, and deeply preoccupied with romance, suitors, and marriage. Though somewhat shallow and prone to hysteria when distressed, she possesses a warm, affectionate nature and genuine goodwill toward her friends. She is social and enthusiastic, particularly when discussing young men or social gatherings.

## Traits

- Romantic and giggly
- Vain about her looks
- Affectionate
- Prone to sentimentality and emotional outbursts

## Abilities

- Teaching elementary school
- Flirting and attracting beaux
- Fancy needlework

## Goals

- To have many suitors and eventually marry well

## History

Ruby Gillis grows up in Avonlea and becomes part of Anne Shirley's circle of school friends, joining their Story Club during her schooldays. She attends Queen's Academy alongside Anne, Gilbert Blythe, and others to earn her teaching license, suffering a hysterical breakdown from exam nerves before passing successfully. After graduating, Ruby takes a teaching position at Carmody School. During her time as a teacher, she continues her keen interest in courtship, boasting to her friends about her numerous beaux and romantic conquests.

## Background by volume

- Grew up in Avonlea as part of the large Gillis family
- Attended Avonlea School alongside Anne Shirley and Diana Barry

## Affiliations

- The Story Club — Member
- Avonlea Arts Improvement Society — Member

## Relationships

### Anne Shirley

- Friend of — Schoolmate and close friend, though Anne sometimes finds Ruby's obsessiveness with beaux tiresome.

### Diana Barry

- Friend of — Childhood friend and member of the same social circle.

### Jane Andrews

- Friend of — Close friend and fellow member of their school social group.
